the application of SVM-based HCC for the SAPF is an effective method to reduce harmonics in the distribution system.

the proposed KF-Adeline algorithm based on space vector modulated HCC based SAPF can effectively mitigate harmonics and improve power quality.

a new control strategy for a shunt active filter to improve the power quality.
the design of an adaptive control algorithm for the shunt APF, which is based on the combination of the KF and the Adaline algorithm.
the design of an efficient control scheme for a three phase shunt active power filters to eliminate current harmonics.

the proposed controller is more effective than the conventional PI controller in terms of THD and Total harmonic distortion (THD) of current.

the proposed controller is better in terms of performance and robustness compared to other conventional methods.

the proposed algorithm can be used for estimation of power harmonics and their mitigation.
